nodes.label: AI Job Search Framework
nodes.rationale: An AI-powered job application framework on Claude Code: fork it, fill in your profile, and let Claude evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, and prep interviews. Core workflow is language- and country-agnostic; portal skills are swappable per market. Independent project, not affiliated with Anthropic.

nodes.label: /apply drafter-reviewer workflow
nodes.rationale: Eight steps: parse posting, evaluate fit, draft LaTeX CV + cover letter, spawn a reviewer agent that researches the company, revise, compile and visually inspect both PDFs, ATS-check the CV text layer, present with a verification checklist. All claims verified against the real profile; nothing fabricated.

nodes.label: /setup profile onboarding
nodes.rationale: Three auto-detected paths (documents folder, single pasted CV, guided interview) all converge on the same populated profile files; documents-folder mode is idempotent and safe to re-run.

nodes.label: /rank ranked shortlist triage
nodes.rationale: Bridges /scrape and /apply when a scrape returns more jobs than you want to eyeball: parallel agents fetch and score each posting on five evaluation dimensions, deal-breakers veto, deadlines get urgency flags, dead postings are marked expired.

nodes.label: /interview stage-specific prep pack
nodes.rationale: Builds prep from the application's own archive (exact posting, the CV and cover letter the interviewer actually read, prior-round feedback), researches company and interviewers with a verify-before-use rule, and gives honest bridge answers for gaps rather than inventing experience.

nodes.label: /outcome result recording and archiving
nodes.rationale: Archives submitted CV, cover letter and posting into documents/applications/<company>_<role>/, keeps outcome.md in the format /setup Path A parses, and updates the tracker. Follow-ups are drafted only from already-submitted claims, never sent, at most twice per application.

nodes.label: /html-report offline tracker dashboard
nodes.rationale: Self-contained HTML with inline SVG charts and no external dependencies so it opens fully offline in a browser.

nodes.label: /gmail-sync application status detection
nodes.rationale: Proposes status changes as a batch for user approval with the source email cited on every change; stops short of proposing hired/offer_declined, and flags conflicting or unmatched signals for a manual /outcome pass instead of guessing.

nodes.label: /notion-sync one-way pipeline view
nodes.rationale: One-way and read-only via the official Notion MCP server (OAuth, no API keys): repo files stay the system of record, nothing syncs back, and documents sync as filenames only. Complements the offline /html-report dashboard with a glanceable live view.

nodes.label: /add-portal portal skill generator
nodes.rationale: Investigates the portal (search-URL pattern, result structure, robots.txt), scaffolds a CLI skill matching the shipped contract, and test-runs a live query before registering. Auth-walled portals are declined; ToS-restricted ones get a personal-use-only warning. The generated skill is market-specific and lives in your fork; the generator is the universal part.

nodes.label: /reset profile and documents wipe
nodes.rationale: Shows exactly what will be deleted and requires typing RESET to confirm; nothing is deleted until then.

nodes.label: PDF Verification Loop
nodes.rationale: Most LaTeX resume templates produce output that looks fine in the .tex but breaks in the PDF: titles orphan across pages, cover letters spill to page 2, bullet fonts silently fall back. /apply compiles, visually inspects, and applies targeted fixes (\needspace, \enlargethispage, font-matching wrappers) until clean.

nodes.label: ATS Verification on the PDF Text Layer
nodes.rationale: An ATS reads embedded text, not the rendered page, and LaTeX can silently emit PDFs whose text extracts as garbage (icon glyphs where the email should be, interleaved multi-column lines). Honesty rule: a keyword the profile does not support is acknowledged as a gap, never stuffed in.

nodes.label: Relevance-Weighted CV Cutting
nodes.rationale: When a CV overflows 2 pages, lines are scored by relevance to the posting, uniqueness in the document, and whether the cover letter depends on them, then the lowest total is cut first - so an older-role bullet hitting posting keywords survives ahead of a recent-role bullet that does not. Avoids mechanically cutting the oldest section.

nodes.label: Drafter-Reviewer Separation
nodes.rationale: A second Claude agent spawned with fresh context researches the company and critiques the drafts, catching missed keywords, weak framing and generic language a single pass leaves in.

nodes.label: Token-Efficient Reviewer Dispatch
nodes.rationale: The reviewer receives drafts inline instead of re-reading them and the checklist runs once at the end rather than in both agents. Stated trade-off: the compile-and-inspect step spends some of those savings on PDF rendering, trading end-to-end token cost for fewer broken PDFs reaching the user.

nodes.label: linkedin-search portal skill
nodes.rationale: Built on LinkedIn's public unauthenticated jobs-guest endpoints, field-agnostic, zero runtime dependencies, location as an explicit flag so it works in any market. Personal use only - automated access violates LinkedIn's ToS, so keep volume low.

nodes.label: freehire-search portal skill
nodes.rationale: Queries a public REST API (JSON, no key), so results come back structured (skills, seniority, category) unlike the HTML-scraping Danish portals. The MIT-licensed backend is self-hostable via FREEHIRE_API_URL.

nodes.label: Profile Depth Matters
nodes.rationale: The single biggest factor in output quality: a thin profile produces generic applications. Skills described in context ("built ML pipelines for churn prediction in Python with scikit-learn") give far more to reframe than a bare keyword list.

nodes.label: Latent Opportunity Discovery
nodes.rationale: Analyzing the actual work done rather than job titles surfaces transferable skills mapping to unexpected industries; describing what energized versus drained you directly shapes fit evaluation and what /scrape surfaces.
